summary: Borr Drilling Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 16, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing publication of a new investor presentation on its website, prepared in connection with Pareto Securities' 33rd Annual Energy Conference. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or structural terms are disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure (the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K furnished exhibit). The registrant is not acting as acquirer, target or issuer in any special situation. What to watch: no deal terms to arbitrage; monitor subsequent 6-K filings and fleet/contract updates.
